bagPolicy.summary: FARGODOME encourages guests not to bring bags to events. Bags larger than 13”x13” are not permitted unless medically necessary.
bagPolicy.note: Oversized bags (diaper bags/medical bags) allowed for necessity will be screened and identified with a colored band.

parking.note: Parking lots at Fargodome open approximately 2 hours before events, with general parking costing $5.00 cash. Bus parking is available in lot E for $15.00 cash per bus. All lots close no more than one hour after the event.

rideshare.note: Buses, limos, Uber, Lyft and other transportation services must drop off and pick up guests on the west side on Albrecht Blvd.

concessions.note: The Fargodome offers alcoholic beverages with a limit of two per purchase, and sales end at the start of the 4th quarter during NDSU Football games. Alcohol service policies may vary for special events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Fargodome, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Fargodome's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Generally, will call is located at the main box office, located in the lobby of the east, main entrance of FARGODOME Box office opens a minimum of 2 hours prior to scheduled event time.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Fargodome. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
